summary: iter319 SPRINT fully validated end-to-end (Global Onboarding + Claude Auto-Screening + In-Admin PDF Preview). BACKEND: 47/47 PASS across (15 iter318 unit + 17 iter318 live + 15 iter319 unit) PLUS 12/12 new live HTTP tests in test_iter319_live.py = 59/59 careers PASS. Iter317 email hub regression 27/27 PASS. Critical proofs: (a) POST /api/careers/jobs/{id}/apply returns 422 missing_country / missing_province (Canada) / missing_state (US) / succeeds with country=France & empty province+state; row persists with country='France'. (b) Country filter on GET /api/admin/careers/applicants?country=Canada works. (c) Inline attachments endpoint with ?inline=1 returns Content-Type=application/pdf + Content-Disposition: inline for .pdf, default returns Content-Disposition: attachment, path traversal still blocked. (d) PATCH /screening/summary updates+pins+stamps summary_edited_by=admin email, empty summary → 422 empty_summary. (e) POST /screen LIVE Claude round-trip works (~3-4s), preserves admin-pinned summary in screening.summary AND stores fresh LLM output in screening.llm_summary. (f) New apply with country=Canada+QC+real PDF triggers BackgroundTask; within ~5s screening.status='ok', recommendation∈{Yes,Maybe,No}, model='anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6'. FRONTEND: /careers/:job_id Step 1 — input-country present as native <select>; Required/Obligatoire validation flagged for missing country; Canada→input-province appears, US→input-state appears, France→both secondary fields hidden (province=0, state=0). /admin/careers Applicants tab — filter-country dropdown present, row-country=7 cells, ai-rec-yes=2/ai-rec-no=1 badges rendered. ApplicantDetailDialog opens with full 2-column layout: ai-screening-panel (rescreen-btn, edit-summary-btn, ai-summary, ai-key-signals, ai-summary-edited-tag showing 'Admin-edited · LLM original below' AND the previously pinned 'TEST iter319 PINNED ...' summary I set via live test) on LEFT, cv-preview-pane with cv-iframe whose src starts with 'blob:' on RIGHT. Edit flow: click edit-summary-btn → edit-summary-textarea + save-summary-btn render. ENDPOINT COUNT: routes/careers.py now has 15 endpoints (not 13 as spec wording said — but two NEW admin endpoints are present and working: POST /admin/careers/applicants/{id}/screen + PATCH /screening/summary). Zero regressions to iter318.

issues: After selecting a country (e.g. France) the previously-shown 'Required / Obligatoire' validation message under the country dropdown does NOT clear until next submit attempt. Minor — does not block submission since the value is valid; client re-validation just runs on next Next click.
Cookie consent banner overlays bottom of viewport — pre-existing from iter318, not iter319-specific. Use force=True for clicks near footer.

action_items: Optional UX polish: clear the country 'Required/Obligatoire' inline error the moment a valid country is selected (currently waits until next submit). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Spec wording said route file has 13 endpoints — actual count is 15 (was 13 before iter319, two NEW added). Functionally correct; just a doc/comment discrepancy.

screen_applicant() correctly stores LLM output in screening.llm_summary when summary_edited=True so the pinned admin override survives re-screens — verified live (Claude call cost ~1 credit during regression run).

Inline attachments endpoint properly switches media_type via file extension map; safe_resolve_download is called BEFORE the inline param is consumed, so ?inline=1 cannot bypass path-traversal protection — verified.
Background task is fire-and-forget with try/except wrapper (_screen_in_background) — apply() never 500s on Claude failure; screening.status='failed' persists silently. Spec-compliant.
PATCH /screening/summary trims+caps summary at 220 chars and rejects empty (422 empty_summary with bilingual envelope) — spec-compliant.
Country filter in admin applicants is server-side (verified via response containing only Canada rows when ?country=Canada). Top-tier filter as required.

Frontend uses native <select> for country/province/state rather than shadcn Select — both work; native is more accessible. data-testids attached at wrapper level for province/state so they're addressable when conditionally rendered.
